ops.body:
Cross-config-root native acceptance remains NOT COVERED (investigation lane xconfig-probe; no commits). The gate is a user login.
Supported mechanisms checked (no secrets read, printed or written):
- cc-pool has no accounts ("No accounts yet"; `cc-pool run` refuses). Per its ARCHITECTURE.md every account needs its own `claude /login`, and credentials are deliberately never adopted.
- Claude Code docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/iam § Credential management): a custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR keys its own macOS Keychain entry, and the .credentials.json fallback moves with it. cc-pool's source derives the item from the literal (non-realpath) dir string.
- No auth env var names, no apiKeyHelper/awsAuthRefresh/forceLoginMethod in settings, no ~/.claude/.credentials.json, no ANTHROPIC_PROFILE setup.
Denial (verbatim, not retried): grepping the installed claude binary for the credential service name → "Permission for this action was denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier. Reason: [Credential Exploration]."
Experiment: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<symlink alias of ~/.claude> → exit 1 "Not logged in · Please run /login". The credential lookup follows the literal string.
Harness: TestNativeAcceptance/cross-config-root SKIPs (NOT-COVERED) without CC_SYNC_ACCEPT_CONFIG_DIR.
REMAINING GATE, needs the user:
- (a) recommended: `! CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.cc-sync-accept claude` then complete /login. This makes an independent grant and leaves plain claude untouched. Then run `CC_SYNC_ACCEPT_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.cc-sync-accept go test -tags native -count=1 -run 'TestNativeAcceptance/cross-config-root$' ./internal/sessionrestore/ -v` from cc-sync.
- (b) `ccp add` would work but writes into a cc-pool profile (disallowed by the constraints).
- (c) coverage from the real second-machine acceptance.
Side effect disclosed: the alias run made Claude write its global config to <alias>/.claude.json = ~/.claude/.claude.json. That is a dormant file plain claude does not read; plain claude uses ~/.claude.json. It grew 389 B → 658 B, with ordinary global-config keys (firstStartTime, machineID, userID, migration flags, seenNotifications, pluginUsage) and no projects key. The prior bytes were not snapshotted, so they cannot be restored exactly. Nothing else changed: live ~/.claude.json and history.jsonl are untouched by this run, and the alias, temp dirs and throwaway project dir were removed and verified.
The harness skip text will be reworded to state the real reason ("Claude keys the Keychain credential to the literal CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR string; a second root needs its own login").
